suggested_requirements.text: The network shall support the GSM teleservices listed in table 2-1.
The network shall support the GSM bearer services listed in table 2-2.
The network shall support the GSM supplementary services listed in table 2-3.
The network shall support the railway specific services listed in table 2-4.
The network shall limit the maximum alerting duration to 60 seconds.
The network shall provide a coverage probability of 95% based on a coverage level of 38.5 dBµV/m for voice and non-safety critical data.
The network shall provide a coverage probability of 95% based on a coverage level of 41.5 dBµV/m on lines with ETCS levels 2/3 for speeds lower than or equal to 220km/h.
The network shall terminate an ongoing VGCS/VBS call upon receiving the 3-digit sequence “***” via DTMF signals.

The network shall send a SET-PARAMETER message with attribute “D-ATT = T” to the talking subscriber's mobile if it receives the 3-digit sequence “###” via DTMF or a group call SETUP message from a controller.
The network shall send a SET-PARAMETER message with attribute “D-ATT = F” to the talking subscriber's mobile only if it receives the 3-digit sequence “#**” via DTMF from all talking controllers.
The Cab radio shall initiate a call to the appropriate controller with ‘Railway operation’ priority upon an appropriate MMI action.
The Cab radio shall initiate a group call using the ‘all trains’ group identification with eMLPP priority level 2 upon a ‘Call other drivers in area’ request.
The Cab radio shall initiate a Railway emergency call upon activation of the ‘Railway emergency call’ function.
The Cab radio shall establish a permanent radio connection between active cabs using the GSM Multi-Party service where multiple traction vehicles are not connected by on-train wiring.
The Cab radio shall initiate a GSM point-to-point voice call at ‘Railway operation’ priority upon activation of the ‘Call train staff’ function.
The Cab radio shall be able to receive, display, and store incoming short (SMS) text messages.
The Cab radio shall register with a mobile network upon switch on.
The Cab radio shall send a USSD message upon activation of the train number registration or deregistration function.
The mobile radio shall prevent the user from entering direct mode if the GSM service is available.
The mobile radio shall automatically re-attempt Railway emergency call setup if the initial attempt is unsuccessful until successful, a 30-second retry timer expires, or the user abandons the call.
